response.sql:
WITH status_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    s.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) as total_scans,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN sc.gbsize ELSE 0 END) as total_gb,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL THEN sc.spanmin ELSE 0 END) as total_span_min
  FROM scans sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
with_gpm AS (
  SELECT 
    healtheval,
    total_scans,
    CASE WHEN total_span_min > 0 THEN total_gb / total_span_min ELSE NULL END as gb_per_minute
  FROM status_stats
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) as avg_value
  FROM with_gpm
  WHERE gb_per_minute IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  with_gpm.healtheval,
  with_gpm.total_scans,
  with_gpm.gb_per_minute,
  with_gpm.gb_per_minute - average_calc.avg_value as exceeds_average
FROM with_gpm
CROSS JOIN average_calc
WHERE average_calc.avg_value IS NOT NULL
  AND with_gpm.gb_per_minute IS NOT NULL
  AND with_gpm.gb_per_minute > average_calc.avg_value
ORDER BY with_gpm.healtheval;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing values" applies only to the GB-per-minute calculation: scans with NULL gbsize or spanmin are excluded from the GB/min denominator, but all scans are included in the total_scans count. Alternatively, incomplete records could be excluded from the entire analysis.

alternatives.interpretation: "Ignoring missing values" means we exclude any scans lacking both gbsize and spanmin from the entire analysis (not just the GB/min calculation), so total_scans counts only complete records.

  SELECT 
    s.healtheval,
    SUM(sc.scancount) as total_scans,
    SUM(sc.gbsize) / SUM(sc.spanmin) as gb_per_minute
  FROM scans sc
  INNER JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.healtheval
),
average_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(gb_per_minute) as avg_value
  FROM status_stats
)
SELECT 
  status_stats.healtheval,
  status_stats.total_scans,
  status_stats.gb_per_minute,
  status_stats.gb_per_minute - average_calc.avg_value as exceeds_average
FROM status_stats
CROSS JOIN average_calc
WHERE average_calc.avg_value IS NOT NULL
  AND status_stats.gb_per_minute > average_calc.avg_value
ORDER BY status_stats.healtheval;
